title: Deeds and Documents (Execution before Public Officers) Ordinance
long_title: AN ORDINANCE TO PROVIDE FOR THE EXECUTION OF DEEDS WHICH ARE REQUIRED TO BE EXECUTED BEFORE AND ATTESTED BY A NOTARY PUBLIC BEFORE AN OFFICER OF GOVERNMENT INSTEAD OF BEFORE A NOTARY.
long_title_raw: AN ORDINANCE TO PROVIDE FOR THE EXECUTION OF DEEDS WHICH ARE REQUIRED TO BE EXECUTED BEFORE AND ATTESTED BY A NOTARY PUBLIC BEFORE AN OFFICER OF GOVERNMENT INSTEAD OF BEFORE A NOTARY.
commencement_source: date printed at the head of the parsed edition, '[ 1 st July , 1853 ]', and given by srilankalaw as '[Date of Commencement: 1st July, 1853]'. There is no SRC070 row in data/processed/statute_commencement.csv. Note the gap: the Ordinance is No. 17 of 1852 but did not come into operation until 1 July 1853.

overrides_applied.note: srilankalaw confirms the section 1 short title and the 1 July 1853 commencement, and prints the same section 3 marginal note. Its section 5 is behind a subscription notice, so the form of certificate could not be read there. Also tried: commonlii's Chapter 85 PDF (403) and lawnet.gov.lk (404 over http, certificate mismatch over https).

quality_flags.detail: Section 5 requires the certifying officer's certificate to be 'in the following form of words ... that is to say,' and the form does not follow. Nothing in this corpus can reproduce the prescribed certificate. Three outside copies were tried and none yielded it.
Section 2 carries two asterisk markers, on 'Court of Requests' and on 'Commissioner', with no footnote text anywhere on the page. Both notes are lost in this edition.
Section 3's second marginal note, 'Copies or extracts how obtained.', was printed inside the body sentence. Removed from text, kept in raw_text, and recorded under additional_headings.

The header block names Ordinance No. 5 of 1875 as amending this Ordinance, but the page carries no inline marker, so which section it changed is not recorded anywhere in this corpus. The amending Ordinance's own text is not held either.
The section 3 body correction and the source_location rest on the parsed page alone. The title and commencement are corroborated by srilankalaw.

source_location.note: An older revised edition carries this as Chapter 85.

body.heading: Short title.
body.raw_text: 1. This Ordinance may be cited as the Deeds and Documents (Execution before Public Officers) Ordinance.
body.text: This Ordinance may be cited as the Deeds and Documents (Execution before Public Officers) Ordinance.

body.heading: Deeds relating to land may be executed before a District Judge or Commissioner, & c.
body.raw_text: 2. Every writing, deed, or instrument which by section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance is required to be executed in the manner therein mentioned in order to its validity, shall, if made after this Ordinance shall come into operation, be valid and effectual, so far as relates to the execution thereof, if the same be signed by the party making the same or by some person lawfully authorized by him, and by two or more witnesses present at the same time, in the presence of some District Judge or Commissioner of a Court of Requests* for the district in which the party making such writing, deed, or instrument, or the person signing the same as such attorney, resides, or in the presence of some Justice of the Peace for such district specially authorized by the Minister of Justice to act in that behalf, and of whose appointment notice shall be given in the Gazette, and if the execution of such writing, deed, or instrument shall be certified at the foot or end thereof under the hand or hand and seal of such Judge or Commissioner*, or of such Justice authorized as aforesaid, anything contained in the said Prevention of Frauds Ordinance to the contrary notwithstanding.
body.text: Every writing, deed, or instrument which by section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance is required to be executed in the manner therein mentioned in order to its validity, shall, if made after this Ordinance shall come into operation, be valid and effectual, so far as relates to the execution thereof, if the same be signed by the party making the same or by some person lawfully authorized by him, and by two or more witnesses present at the same time, in the presence of some District Judge or Commissioner of a Court of Requests* for the district in which the party making such writing, deed, or instrument, or the person signing the same as such attorney, resides, or in the presence of some Justice of the Peace for such district specially authorized by the Minister of Justice to act in that behalf, and of whose appointment notice shall be given in the Gazette, and if the execution of such writing, deed, or instrument shall be certified at the foot or end thereof under the hand or hand and seal of such Judge or Commissioner*, or of such Justice authorized as aforesaid, anything contained in the said Prevention of Frauds Ordinance to the contrary notwithstanding.

cross_references.verbatim: section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance

body.marker_note: 'Court of Requests*' and 'Commissioner*' carry footnote markers. The page contains no footnote text for either; the only bracketed span on it is the head date. The notes are lost in this edition, so editorial_notes is empty rather than guessed at.

body.heading: They shall be executed in duplicate and registered.
body.raw_text: 3. Provided that every such writing, deed, or instrument shall be executed in duplicate, which duplicate shall be delivered or transmitted by such Judge, Copies or extracts how obtained. Commissioner, or Justice to the Registrar of Lands in accordance with section 4 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance to be by him registered and preserved in the Land Registry in like manner as notarial deeds of a similar description; and all persons interested in any such deed shall be entitled, on furnishing the proper stamp, to demand a copy or extract of such deed, certified as correct by the said Registrar of Lands, for which copy or extract a fee of two rupees shall be paid to the said Registrar of Lands who shall pay the same into the Treasury.

body.heading: Manner of execution of such deeds.
body.raw_text: 4. No such Judge, Commissioner, or Justice as aforesaid shall be authorized to certify the execution of any such writing, deed, or instrument unless the same, and the duplicate thereof, shall be duly stamped as required by law, nor until the same shall have been read over and explained to the party making the same, and to the witnesses thereto, by or in the presence of such Judge, Commissioner, or Justice as aforesaid, nor unless the same, and the duplicate thereof, shall be legibly written or engrossed, without erasures therein, nor unless the party making such writing, deed, or instrument shall be known to such Judge, Commissioner, or Justice as aforesaid, or to at least two of the attesting witnesses thereto, who shall make a declaration to that effect before him.
body.text: No such Judge, Commissioner, or Justice as aforesaid shall be authorized to certify the execution of any such writing, deed, or instrument unless the same, and the duplicate thereof, shall be duly stamped as required by law, nor until the same shall have been read over and explained to the party making the same, and to the witnesses thereto, by or in the presence of such Judge, Commissioner, or Justice as aforesaid, nor unless the same, and the duplicate thereof, shall be legibly written or engrossed, without erasures therein, nor unless the party making such writing, deed, or instrument shall be known to such Judge, Commissioner, or Justice as aforesaid, or to at least two of the attesting witnesses thereto, who shall make a declaration to that effect before him.

body.heading: Form of certificate.
body.raw_text: 5. Every such Judge, Commissioner, or Justice as aforesaid shall insert in his certificate of the execution of every such writing, deed, or instrument, the day, month, and year on which and the place where the same is executed, together with the names and residences of the attesting witnesses; and such certificate shall be in the following form of words, or in any other form of words to the same effect; that is to say,

body.content_note: The section ends 'in the following form of words ... that is to say,' and the page then goes straight to the section 6 marginal note. The prescribed form of certificate, which is the operative content of this section, is absent from this edition.

body.heading: No fees to be taken. Penalty.
body.raw_text: 6. No fee or gratuity shall be received or taken by any such Judge or Commissioner, or by any such Justice authorized by the Minister of Justice as aforesaid, of or from any person whomsoever for certifying the execution of any such writing, deed, or instrument, or for any act done or to be done by any such Judge, Commissioner, or Justice under this Ordinance; and any such officer who shall receive or take any fee or gratuity contrary to the true intent and meaning of this Ordinance shall be liable on conviction thereof to a fine not exceeding two hundred rupees.
body.text: No fee or gratuity shall be received or taken by any such Judge or Commissioner, or by any such Justice authorized by the Minister of Justice as aforesaid, of or from any person whomsoever for certifying the execution of any such writing, deed, or instrument, or for any act done or to be done by any such Judge, Commissioner, or Justice under this Ordinance; and any such officer who shall receive or take any fee or gratuity contrary to the true intent and meaning of this Ordinance shall be liable on conviction thereof to a fine not exceeding two hundred rupees.

body.heading: Deeds not to be written by such Judges, & c, or by the officers of their courts. Penalty.
body.raw_text: 7. No such Judge or Commissioner, and no such Justice authorized by the Minister of Justice as aforesaid, and no registrar, clerk, interpreter, or other officer of any court presided over by such Judge or Commissioner shall draw up, write, or engross any writing, deed, or instrument to be executed under the provisions of this Ordinance, or any duplicate thereof; and any such officer who shall draw up, write, or engross any such writing, deed, or instrument, or the duplicate thereof, contrary to the true intent and meaning of this Ordinance, shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding two hundred rupees.
